result.patientSummary:
Dear Syn,

We completed a composite restoration on the occlusal surface of tooth #46 to treat the carious lesion identified during your examination. You reported feeling much better after the treatment. Continue your regular oral hygiene routine, brushing twice daily with fluoride toothpaste and flossing daily. If you experience any increased sensitivity, pain, or notice the restoration feeling loose, please contact us promptly.

Kind regards,
Your Dental Team
